dct_description_sm: This data set was collected as a part of the ArcticNet project, 'Integrated Marine Geoscience to Guide Environmental Impact Assessment and Sustainable Development in Frobisher Bay, Nunavut'. The goals for this year included mapping glacial landforms on the seabed of Frobisher Bay, completing mapping of previously partially imaged submarine slope failures in the inner bay, and investigating possible submerged coastlines in the outer bay. This data set contributes 655 square kilometres of coverage to multibeam data collected in previous years in the region.
dct_title_s: 2015 Multibeam and Shallow Sub-Bottom Data from Frobisher Bay, Baffin Island, Nunavut collected aboard MV Nuliajuk
